answer: Identity bond natural decay: each new identity posts a 40 POA bond, earning nothing, shrinking 2 POA per idle epoch; only work refreshes it. Every epoch brings a tide of new identities; idle bonds bleed into relics. Trust grows like a pearl, each job adding 2 POA. Forging 100 fakes costs 4,000 POA, losing 200 POA each idle epoch; an honest agent posts 40 POA once, topped up by work. Hoarding bleeds; honest agents pay once, earnings undiluted.
